text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
All right, who was the fool that said the
race
would be too short for her, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No kidding... Kitasan Black doesn't mess
around...
She blew it out of the water
this time too...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Huff... huff... I don't have anything I'm particularly good at, nor can I steal the show in any way. But despite that...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I'm not bad at anything, either! I've
conquered
my weaknesses! Whether
they're 2,000 or 3,000
meters long, I'll
run 'em all!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I did it, Dia. I've completed my first
goal of the
year!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let this be enough to reach the very
end!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! There's nothing I can't
do, and
no path I can't run through to
the end!
choice_data_list: キタサン、よくやった。次だな
キタサン、よくやったよ。次だね

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I won this race, and I'll win the next one
too! An
uphill battle over 3,000 meters
long for that
brilliant plaque!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Bring on the spring Tenno Sho! I'm out
to prove
that anyone can make it big if
they work hard
enough!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I dunno how to explain it, but... watching
Kitasan
Black run makes me feel inspired
for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She makes me feel like even
average Joes
like us could make it big if
we put our noses to
the grindstone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Elsewhere, a few days later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooooosh!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're back. It's good to see you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You seem to have fully recovered from
your
surgery. You've made your
domestic comeback
and were even able
to shine in the UAE G1 world.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do you feel ready for the task ahead?

text_block_list.name: Brusquement
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A great deal has transpired while you
were
running internationally.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Which race would you like to run in
next? We
cannot make a final decision
without your
trainer's input, of course...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But why don't we go pick flowers?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To make up for the chrysanthemum we
forgot to
pluck last year at a certain
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many things are being put into motion
ahead of
our next goal, the spring Tenno
Sho.
